bio.text: Eunice Lehmacher won the 2026 Democratic primary for South Carolina's 3rd Congressional District over Ernest Mackins, according to NBC News results; the seat is held by Republican Rep. Sheri Biggs.
According to Upstate Today, her earlier careers include work as a high school teacher, librarian, social worker and psychotherapist.
